gaps.subject: operation
gaps.followUp: M2 XLS font, number-format and protection setters
gaps.reason: alignment, border line styles and palette fill colors are written through a reused or authored XF; font, border colors, number format, protection, rotation and reading order are read-only because a new XF must keep an existing font/number-format/protection prefix, and formatting is set in its own call rather than together with value, clear or formula

gaps.subject: operation
gaps.reason: an existing Formula record (possibly a shared, array or table owner, or a string-cache group) is not replaced by a value, clear or new formula; authored formulas use the BIFF8 tokenizer, which refuses 3-D, external and name references, and carry an empty cached result with always-recalculate set

gaps.subject: operation
gaps.reason: admitted scalar storage-family replacements preserve the XF and use native row-block and SST rewrites; packed MulBlank cells, unsupported formula ownership, non-adjacent ExtSST records and removal of the last rich or opaque string identity remain typed refusals until their dependency closures and semantic inverses are represented

gaps.subject: operation

gaps.subject: operation

gaps.subject: operation
